description: Two sends for a modular mixer: each takes a signal, scales it and adds it to a send chain that passes through the module

params.text: Sets how much of that half's input signal is added to the chain, from none of it to all of it
Ties the two halves together so that one SEND knob governs both; its lamp is lit while it is on

inputs.text: A voltage here takes over from that half's SEND knob, 0V to 10V across none of the signal to all of it
The send chain arriving from another module; this half adds its own send to whatever is here
The signal that half sends into the chain

outputs.text: The chain signal of that half plus the signal at its IN, scaled by that half's SEND knob
Copies the signal at that half's IN, untouched
